definition_used: One or more third parties objected to the notice or the wording of the notice.
caution: The reason describes a post-publication objection to a notice, which is a transparency/due-process signal, not a direct indicator of manuscript content or authorship issues. It is status-oriented and does not inherently imply research unreliability or misconduct.
semantic_rationale: The definition centers on third-party objections to a notice, which falls under post-publication transparency and due process oversight, as it concerns the handling and wording of retraction or correction notices.
